# 2_extracted_text

The book's text is extracted to the code cache, outside the repo (copyright). This folder keeps only the **sections file** (`gov.ny.building.2025.sections.jsonl`): the brought-in pages cut into pieces at the book's own headings, each with its section number, title, line ranges, a fingerprint of its words, and the definitions it uses (by its italics, 201.1). Tables are pieces of their own. No words of the book but section titles and defined terms.

**Generated by code only. Never hand-edit.** `python -m document_extraction` reads the brought-in pages from the cache (`layout: icc`, `style: bcnys_2025`: `packages/document_extraction/document_extraction/icc_sections.py`) and writes it; `--check` fails if it differs from a fresh extraction. Where the cache is missing (CI), it is skipped and says so.
